messages_deleted_conversation_delete.name: messages_deleted_conversation_delete
messages_deleted_conversation_delete.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations c WHERE c.id = messages.conversation_id AND c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)

messages_reviewed_question_insert.name: messages_reviewed_question_insert
messages_reviewed_question_insert.withCheck:
role = 'USER' AND kind = 'QUESTION' AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND policy_version IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM input_safety_reviews review WHERE review.accepted_message_id = messages.id
      AND review.conversation_id = messages.conversation_id AND review.decision = 'ALLOW'
      AND review.policy_version = messages.policy_version)

messages_reviewed_answer_insert.name: messages_reviewed_answer_insert
messages_reviewed_answer_insert.withCheck:
role = 'ASSISTANT' AND kind IN ('ANSWER','CLARIFICATION') AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND policy_version IS NOT NULL
    AND jsonb_array_length(parts) = 1 AND parts->0->>'type' = 'text'
    AND parts->0 = jsonb_build_object('type','text','text',parts->0->>'text')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM output_safety_reviews review WHERE review.message_id = messages.id
      AND review.conversation_id = messages.conversation_id AND review.decision = 'ALLOW'
      AND review.policy_version = messages.policy_version
      AND review.body_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(parts->0->>'text','UTF8')),'hex'))

messages_approval_policy.name: messages_approval_policy
messages_approval_policy.value: "messages"."approved_at" IS NULL OR "messages"."policy_version" IS NOT NULL

admission_attempt_window_valid.name: admission_attempt_window_valid
admission_attempt_window_valid.value: ("admission_attempt_buckets"."kind" = 'MINUTE' AND "admission_attempt_buckets"."ends_at" = "admission_attempt_buckets"."starts_at" + interval '1 minute') OR ("admission_attempt_buckets"."kind" = 'DAY' AND "admission_attempt_buckets"."ends_at" = "admission_attempt_buckets"."starts_at" + interval '1 day')

runs_versions_nonempty.name: runs_versions_nonempty
runs_versions_nonempty.value: length(trim("runs"."hmac_key_id")) > 0 AND length(trim("runs"."catalog_version")) > 0 AND length(trim("runs"."price_version")) > 0 AND length(trim("runs"."entitlement_version")) > 0 AND length(trim("runs"."operator_budget_key")) > 0 AND length(trim("runs"."policy_version")) > 0 AND length(trim("runs"."model_key")) > 0

input_review_metadata_valid.name: input_review_metadata_valid
input_review_metadata_valid.value: "input_safety_reviews"."attempt_version" > 0 AND "input_safety_reviews"."duration_ms" >= 0 AND length(trim("input_safety_reviews"."detector_version")) > 0 AND length(trim("input_safety_reviews"."policy_version")) > 0 AND ("input_safety_reviews"."model_id" IS NULL OR length(trim("input_safety_reviews"."model_id")) > 0)

input_review_message_valid.name: input_review_message_valid
input_review_message_valid.value: "input_safety_reviews"."accepted_message_role" = 'USER' AND (("input_safety_reviews"."decision" = 'ALLOW' AND "input_safety_reviews"."accepted_message_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("input_safety_reviews"."decision" <> 'ALLOW' AND "input_safety_reviews"."accepted_message_id" IS NULL))

input_review_categories_valid.name: input_review_categories_valid
input_review_categories_valid.value: array_position("input_safety_reviews"."category_codes",NULL) IS NULL AND "input_safety_reviews"."category_codes" <@ ARRAY['CREDENTIAL_THEFT','FRAUD','UNAUTHORIZED_INTRUSION','MALWARE','VIOLENCE','SEXUAL_EXPLOITATION','SELF_HARM_INSTRUCTIONS','SELF_HARM_DISTRESS','PRIVATE_DATA','ACCIDENTAL_SECRET','PROMPT_INJECTION']::text[] AND (("input_safety_reviews"."decision" = 'BLOCK' AND cardinality("input_safety_reviews"."category_codes") BETWEEN 1 AND 11) OR ("input_safety_reviews"."decision" <> 'BLOCK' AND cardinality("input_safety_reviews"."category_codes") = 0))

retrieval_outcome_valid.name: retrieval_outcome_valid
retrieval_outcome_valid.value: "run_retrievals"."status" IN ('STARTED','READY','NO_EVIDENCE','BLOCKED','UNAVAILABLE') AND ("run_retrievals"."query_verdict" IS NULL OR "run_retrievals"."query_verdict" IN ('ALLOW','BLOCK','UNAVAILABLE')) AND ("run_retrievals"."evidence_verdict" IS NULL OR "run_retrievals"."evidence_verdict" IN ('ALLOW','BLOCK','UNAVAILABLE')) AND ("run_retrievals"."search_credits" IS NULL OR "run_retrievals"."search_credits" BETWEEN 1 AND 2)

retrieval_ready_reviewed.name: retrieval_ready_reviewed
retrieval_ready_reviewed.value: "run_retrievals"."status" NOT IN ('READY','NO_EVIDENCE') OR ("run_retrievals"."query_verdict" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'ALLOW' AND coalesce("run_retrievals"."search_credits",0) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND ("run_retrievals"."status" = 'NO_EVIDENCE' OR "run_retrievals"."evidence_verdict" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'ALLOW'))

sources_reviewed_insert.name: sources_reviewed_insert
sources_reviewed_insert.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_retrievals r WHERE r.run_id = "run_sources"."run_id" AND r.status = 'READY' AND r.query_verdict = 'ALLOW' AND r.evidence_verdict = 'ALLOW')

source_metadata_valid.name: source_metadata_valid
source_metadata_valid.value: "run_sources"."source_key" ~ '^S[1-5]$' AND "run_sources"."rank" BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND length(trim("run_sources"."title")) > 0 AND "run_sources"."url" ~ '^https?://'

passages_reviewed_insert.name: passages_reviewed_insert
passages_reviewed_insert.withCheck: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_retrievals r WHERE r.run_id = "source_passages"."run_id" AND r.status = 'READY' AND r.query_verdict = 'ALLOW' AND r.evidence_verdict = 'ALLOW')

passage_content_valid.name: passage_content_valid
passage_content_valid.value: length("source_passages"."excerpt") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND length(trim("source_passages"."excerpt")) > 0 AND "source_passages"."content_kind" IN ('SEARCH_PASSAGE','EXTRACTED_PAGE') AND "source_passages"."content_hash" = encode(sha256(convert_to("source_passages"."excerpt",'UTF8')),'hex')

output_review_content_valid.name: output_review_content_valid
output_review_content_valid.value: ("output_safety_reviews"."decision" = 'ALLOW' AND "output_safety_reviews"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."body_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."payload_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."payload" IS NOT NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."body_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "output_safety_reviews"."payload_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof("output_safety_reviews"."payload") = 'object' AND ("output_safety_reviews"."payload"->>'runId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "output_safety_reviews"."run_id"::text AND jsonb_typeof("output_safety_reviews"."payload"->'markdown') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'string' AND "output_safety_reviews"."body_hash" = encode(sha256(convert_to("output_safety_reviews"."payload"->>'markdown','UTF8')),'hex')) OR ("output_safety_reviews"."decision" <> 'ALLOW' AND "output_safety_reviews"."message_id" IS NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."body_hash" IS NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."payload_hash" IS NULL AND "output_safety_reviews"."payload" IS NULL)

provider_cap_valid.name: provider_cap_valid
provider_cap_valid.value: "provider_calls"."cap_micro_usd" > 0 AND "provider_calls"."cap_micro_usd" = CASE WHEN "provider_calls"."budget_version"=1 THEN CASE "provider_calls"."stage" WHEN 'PLANNER' THEN 2000 WHEN 'INPUT_SAFETY' THEN 5000 WHEN 'QUERY_SAFETY' THEN 5000 WHEN 'SEARCH' THEN 8000 WHEN 'EVIDENCE_SAFETY' THEN 5000 WHEN 'ANSWER' THEN 20000 WHEN 'OUTPUT_SAFETY' THEN 5000 ELSE -1 END WHEN "provider_calls"."budget_version"=2 THEN CASE "provider_calls"."stage" WHEN 'PLANNER' THEN 2000 WHEN 'INPUT_SAFETY' THEN 2250 WHEN 'QUERY_SAFETY' THEN 2250 WHEN 'QUERY_SECOND' THEN 2250 WHEN 'SEARCH' THEN 8000 WHEN 'SEARCH_SECOND' THEN 8000 WHEN 'EXTRACT' THEN 8000 WHEN 'EVIDENCE_SAFETY' THEN 2250 WHEN 'ANSWER' THEN 12500 WHEN 'OUTPUT_SAFETY' THEN 2250 ELSE -1 END ELSE -1 END

provider_usage_valid.name: provider_usage_valid
provider_usage_valid.value: ("provider_calls"."cost_micro_usd" IS NULL OR "provider_calls"."cost_micro_usd" >= 0) AND ("provider_calls"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "provider_calls"."input_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND ("provider_calls"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "provider_calls"."output_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000) AND ("provider_calls"."search_credits" IS NULL OR ("provider_calls"."stage"='EXTRACT' AND "provider_calls"."search_credits" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 OR "provider_calls"."stage" IN ('SEARCH','SEARCH_SECOND') AND "provider_calls"."search_credits"=1))

provider_lifecycle_valid.name: provider_lifecycle_valid
provider_lifecycle_valid.value: ("provider_calls"."status" = 'STARTED' AND "provider_calls"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "provider_calls"."cost_micro_usd" IS NULL) OR ("provider_calls"."status" <> 'STARTED' AND "provider_calls"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_calls"."finished_at" >= "provider_calls"."started_at" AND ("provider_calls"."status" <> 'SKIPPED' OR "provider_calls"."cost_micro_usd" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 0))

usage_resolution_valid.name: usage_resolution_valid
usage_resolution_valid.value: "provider_usage_resolutions"."cost_micro_usd" BETWEEN 0 AND 150000 AND "provider_usage_resolutions"."kind" IN ('PROVIDER_RECEIPT','VERIFIED_NOT_BILLED') AND ("provider_usage_resolutions"."kind" <> 'VERIFIED_NOT_BILLED' OR "provider_usage_resolutions"."cost_micro_usd"=0) AND "provider_usage_resolutions"."evidence_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

plan_metadata_valid.name: plan_metadata_valid
plan_metadata_valid.value: "run_plans"."attempt_version">0 AND "run_plans"."message_role"='USER' AND "run_plans"."version" IN ('planner-v1','planner-v2','planner-v3','planner-v4','planner-v5') AND "run_plans"."original_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof("run_plans"."plan")='object' AND coalesce("run_plans"."plan"->>'action','') IN ('ANSWER','CLARIFY') AND jsonb_typeof("run_plans"."context_ids")='array' AND jsonb_array_length("run_plans"."context_ids")<=6

feedback_reviewed_insert.name: feedback_reviewed_insert
feedback_reviewed_insert.withCheck: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM output_safety_reviews o JOIN runs r ON r.id=o.run_id WHERE o.run_id=message_feedback.run_id AND o.message_id=message_feedback.message_id AND o.conversation_id=message_feedback.conversation_id AND o.decision='ALLOW' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED','NEEDS_CLARIFICATION'))

feedback_reviewed_update.name: feedback_reviewed_update
feedback_reviewed_update.using: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM output_safety_reviews o JOIN runs r ON r.id=o.run_id WHERE o.run_id=message_feedback.run_id AND o.message_id=message_feedback.message_id AND o.conversation_id=message_feedback.conversation_id AND o.decision='ALLOW' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED','NEEDS_CLARIFICATION'))
feedback_reviewed_update.withCheck: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM output_safety_reviews o JOIN runs r ON r.id=o.run_id WHERE o.run_id=message_feedback.run_id AND o.message_id=message_feedback.message_id AND o.conversation_id=message_feedback.conversation_id AND o.decision='ALLOW' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED','NEEDS_CLARIFICATION'))

feedback_value_valid.name: feedback_value_valid
feedback_value_valid.value: "message_feedback"."message_role"='ASSISTANT' AND "message_feedback"."version">0 AND "message_feedback"."rating" IN ('HELPFUL','NOT_HELPFUL') AND ("message_feedback"."reason" IS NULL OR "message_feedback"."rating"='NOT_HELPFUL' AND "message_feedback"."reason" IN ('MISSING_EVIDENCE','WRONG_INTERPRETATION','FALSE_REFUSAL')) AND "message_feedback"."updated_at">="message_feedback"."created_at"
